definitions.gloss: final day of a performance run; closing day of a sumo tournament
definitions.explanation: The last day of a series of performances, exhibitions, or a sumo tournament. Originally a term from traditional performing arts, now widely used for any concluding event in a run.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}が{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}だ。
{大相撲|おおずもう}の{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}で{優勝|ゆうしょう}が{決|き}まった。
examples.english: The championship was decided on the final day of the grand sumo tournament.

examples.japanese: このミュージカルは{来週|らいしゅう}の{日曜日|にちようび}に{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}を{迎|むか}えるので、まだ{観|み}ていない{方|かた}はお{早|はや}めに。
examples.english: This musical reaches its final performance next Sunday, so if you haven't seen it yet, please hurry.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Originally from Buddhist gagaku music — the last piece played at a temple ceremony was called {千秋楽|せんしゅうらく} ("a thousand autumns of joy"). It was adopted into kabuki and other performing arts to refer to the final performance.

USAGE:
Commonly abbreviated to {楽日|らくび} or {楽|らく} in theater circles. Most widely associated with sumo and theater.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}を{迎|むか}える (to reach the final day)
- {千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}{公演|こうえん} (closing performance)
- {大相撲|おおずもう}の{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく} (final day of a sumo tournament)
